subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

Professor Singh is not in the office today. I __ask you try call__ him tomorrow.
solution: The correct answer is: **Option 4**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The phrase **"suggest you try calling"** means recommending someone to make an attempt to call. (आपको कॉल करने की सलाह देना) • **Example: **I **suggest you try calling **her in the evening when she's usually free. • **"Try"** refers to making an attempt or effort to do something. (प्रयास करना) • **Example: **He will** try **to finish his homework before dinner. • Hence, we can infer that the correct phrase is **"suggest you try calling"**. Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 4**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **Option 1: asked you to call** (आपसे कॉल करने को कहा): • **Example:** She asked you to call her when you get home. • **Option 2: am suggesting you calling** (मैं आपको कॉल करने का सुझाव दे रहा हूँ): • **Example: **I am suggesting you calling him to resolve the issue. • **Option 3: ask you to try called** (आपसे प्रयास करने के लिए कहा): • **Example: **They ask you to try called the support team for assistance. 3a:Taa0, The correct answer is: **Option 4**.
